id.description: A word of lower-case letters and digits, 1 to 32: the offer made of an account is `ID:ACCOUNT`.

title.description: What the service is called: an offer reads `TITLE, account NAME`.

summary.description: What it is, in a sentence.

location.description: Where the text goes, in a sentence or two.

standard.description: The credential standard an account's kind provides for the account to be this service's.

address.description: The address the kind's model API is called at when nothing moves it.

url.description: The address text is posted to (`speech_say_endpoint`), or the service's speech address.

credential.description: The credential of the account that holds the key, handed as `api_key`.

provider.description: The `speech_output` provider id that speaks for this service (such as `speech_say_openai` or `speech_say_endpoint`).

models.description: Models to pass in settings when the provider takes them (`speech_say_endpoint`), recommended one first.

voices.description: Voices to pass in settings when the provider takes them (`speech_say_endpoint`).

styles.description: Styles to pass in settings when the provider takes them (`speech_say_endpoint`), each `name=instruction`.
